title: Stateless signed extended drainage exchange production-path candidate
purpose: Move the retained SWAP extended drainage/infiltration constitutive law out of the legacy surface-water container without moving surface-water storage, availability or management ownership back into SWAP.

current_canonical_gap.simple_linear_provider: src/process/mod_drainage_process.f90 is positive-only and returns zero for negative head difference
current_canonical_gap.missing_component: no canonical production provider implements the restricted signed extended exchange law

candidate.input: process_hydraulic_view_t groundwater level and ponding depth plus an explicit resolved external surface-water control head
candidate.output: one authoritative signed soil-to-surface transfer, resolved drain level, effective head difference, branch metadata and analytic partial derivatives

explicitly_excluded_ownership: WLSTAR, DROPR or management calendar/event state
pass_criteria: All 1507 candidate cases match an independently coded source-derived oracle for status, branch and signed flux.
Smooth-branch analytic partial derivatives with respect to groundwater level, external control head and ponding depth match the oracle within 5e-11 scaled absolute tolerance.
The seven explicit seam/hold cases preserve branch-boundary metadata or fail closed for negative power interflow.
O0 and O2 textual result streams are identical.
No SAVE state, storage state, availability limiter, management state or Ribasim API dependency occurs in the candidate.
handoff_if_pass: Q4B may bind this provider as a new drainage-response variant and qualify signed runtime booking/rollback. Q4A alone is not runtime or production admission.
